svg.title: Newsbee layered architecture
svg.desc: Three distinct lanes: source-specific news agents and ingestion orchestrator, backend publishing services and workers, and reader, advertiser and publisher interfaces.

g.text: Data acquisition above. Publishing services in the middle. Reader and operator surfaces below.
Solid arrows = content, events or service interaction | Dashed arrows = scheduling or policy | Dashed boxes = data artifacts
Acquisition cadence is separate from the weekly publishing cadence. Source internals remain blackboxed.
Conceptual responsibilities; not prescribed deployable services. Supporting records stay with their owning service.
Policy also governs writing, eligibility, ads and corrections
Central publisher owns policy changes. Review outcomes inform improvement; they do not automatically loosen publishing rules.
Reader access requires no account. Internal publisher controls remain separate from public pages.
OPEN: geography / essential-news rubric / review capacity / publication timing / measurement limits
Proposed structural view. No technology, vendor or deployment choices implied.
MVP target: useful weekly publications across multiple communities, with bounded human effort and maintained editorial quality.
